id: title:haacked:omit person properties from flag evaluations

review.posthog_relevance: Changes ingestion and wire format for flag evaluation, removing person/group properties from ClickHouse rows and TypeScript types, relying on ClickHouse defaults and existing stored values.
review.reason: The chunk removes `person_properties` and `group0..group4_properties` from the ingestion mapper and the emitted `FlagEvaluationRow` type. P1.F1.H1 documents the ingestion path change, noting that ClickHouse fills omitted columns with empty values and existing rows retain stored values. P1.F3.H3 removes the assignment of these properties from the generated row, aligning the code. No

observations.behavior: Documentation and code removal of person_properties and group0..group4_properties from flag evaluation ingestion and wire format.
observations.code_quote: The ingestion mapper omits `person_properties` and `group0..group4_properties` from flag-evaluation rows. ClickHouse fills these omitted string columns with empty values; existing rows keep their stored values. Event `properties` and `person_id` are still sent.
observations.posthog_connection: This documents a change to the ingestion path for flag evaluations, removing person/group properties from the row sent to ClickHouse, relying on ClickHouse defaults to fill omitted columns with empty strings.

observations.behavior: Removes person_properties and group0..group4_properties from the FlagEvaluationRow TypeScript type and the emitted object properties.
observations.posthog_connection: This removes the assignment of person_properties and group0..group4_properties from the generated row, aligning the ingestion implementation with the documented and tested behavior.
